parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key. A retried request with the same key and an identical body returns the original run (200, not 201) instead of launching a duplicate GPU job. The same key replayed with a different body is a conflict — see 409.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (pagination).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of items to skip from the start (pagination).

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Restrict results to runs created by this identity. Omitted: defaults to the caller's own identity. Only callers with the `deft:admin` scope may query a different identity or pass `owner=*` for all runs.

parameters.name: keep_artifacts
parameters.description: If true, delete the run record but preserve its on-disk artifacts (checkpoints, logs, reports). Defaults to false: artifacts are deleted along with the record.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Must be explicitly set to true. Guards against deleting every run when no state/older_than filter is supplied.

post.description: Request cancellation of a pending or running fine-tune run. Idempotent for already-terminal runs. Cancellation is cooperative: the current stage is allowed to reach its next checkpointable boundary (the same boundary an unattended crash would leave behind) before the run is marked `cancelled`, so `deft_state.json` is left in the same resumable state a stage-`error` would produce. A cancelled run may be resumed via POST .../resume like any other stopped run; resuming re-enters at the last completed stage, not partway through the cancelled one.

path.title: Path
path.description: Object location relative to the workspace/snapshot root (e.g. kpi/images/a.jpg).

url.title: Url
url.description: Presigned http(s) GET URL for this object.

path.title: Path
path.description: URI to the raw-frame data pool. `s3://` requires `storage_access` on the request; `file://`/`lustre://` must already be mounted on the runner host.

files.title: Files
files.description: Presigned per-object snapshot manifest — an alternative to an s3:// 'path' prefix. Every object is downloaded to workspace/<path>. When set it wins over 'path' for materialization ('path' may then be the snapshot's logical s3:// URI for reference).

model.title: Model
model.description: Embedding model. SigLIP/CLIP, or a TAO checkpoint via model_path (+ model_config_path).

num_gpus.title: Num Gpus
num_gpus.description: Bounded by cluster GPU capacity; requests above the configured ceiling are rejected with 422.

model_config_path.title: Model Config Path
model_config_path.description: Path to the matching TAO train-spec YAML. Required only when model_path is a TAO .pth/.ckpt checkpoint (needed to reconstruct the encoder); omit for SigLIP/CLIP.

classes.title: Classes
classes.description: Per-class confidence threshold, used only by object-detection workflows (e.g. tmm_only / grounding_dino). VisualChangeNet-classify workflows (e.g. aoi_active_learning) are a binary PASS/defect classifier and ignore this field — leave it unset for those workflows.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: Typed partial ExperimentConfig merged over the selected profile/workflow defaults.

storage_access.description: Temporary, scoped credentials DEFT uses to read/write S3-compatible storage directly for the duration of the run. Only required for `s3://` paths in `data_pool`/`kpi`/`training` config. `file://` and `lustre://` paths are assumed to already be mounted on the runner host (the same filesystem the DEFT service and its worker containers share) and need no credential here. Never logged or echoed back in any response.

path.title: Path
path.description: URI to the KPI test images. `s3://` requires `storage_access` on the request; `file://`/`lustre://` must already be mounted on the runner host.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: k-NN distance metric (knn_metric). cosine for SigLIP/CLIP embeddings; euclidean/manhattan otherwise.

topn.title: Topn
topn.description: Top-N nearest pool images retained per weak target (the AOI mining-count param; the grounding-dino workflow uses desired_unique_count + multiplier instead).

min_similarity.title: Min Similarity
min_similarity.description: Cosine-similarity retention gate for real images (config.mining_filter.min_similarity). Defaults to 0.9 when unset.

filter_by_label.title: Filter By Label
filter_by_label.description: Label-aware mining: only mine within the same label. Requires a `label` column in both embedding parquets (silent no-op otherwise).

desired_unique_count.title: Desired Unique Count
desired_unique_count.description: Target number of unique mined images (mining-count control used by the grounding-dino / object-detection workflow).

multiplier.title: Multiplier
multiplier.description: Over-fetch multiplier applied to desired_unique_count before dedup (grounding-dino / object-detection workflow).

MiningConfig.title: MiningConfig
MiningConfig.description: `topn` (AOI k-NN retention) and `desired_unique_count`+`multiplier` (grounding-dino / object-detection over-fetch) are mutually exclusive parameterizations for two different workflow families — set one or the other, never both.

kpi_target.title: Kpi Target
kpi_target.description: KPI stop condition (the primary AOI convergence gate). The loop stops when this target is met. Stored as deft_state.kpi_target.

num_sdg.title: Num Sdg
num_sdg.description: Per-iteration AnomalyGen sample budget for the on-fly AnomalyGen (routing) path. Unused by the pre-generated EA variant, where synthetic volume is emergent (topn x num_weak_targets).

description.title: Description
examples: Grounding DINO profile tuned for the Santomas dataset.

examples.name: santomas_gdino
examples.description: Grounding DINO profile tuned for the Santomas dataset.

completed_steps.title: Completed Steps
completed_steps.description: Number of workflow steps completed in the current iteration.

total_steps.title: Total Steps
total_steps.description: Total workflow steps expected in the current iteration: rca, routing, anomalygen, data_mining, train, evaluate.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Decision threshold at recall=100% on the KPI set. Always use this value, never a spec/model default — it is the operating point the reported far_pct was measured at.

far_pct.title: Far Pct
far_pct.description: False-accept rate achieved at `threshold`. Surface to operators alongside scores.

backbone.title: Backbone
backbone.description: Path to the backbone checkpoint required to load best_checkpoint.

images_dir.title: Images Dir
images_dir.description: Image root the model was evaluated against; a useful default for re-running on KPI data.

training_spec.title: Training Spec
training_spec.description: Training spec YAML used to produce best_checkpoint; read this for fields not exposed elsewhere in this response.

best_checkpoint_sha256.title: Best Checkpoint Sha256
best_checkpoint_sha256.description: SHA-256 content digest (hex) of the best checkpoint file. Consumers that stage the artifact (e.g. the Model Manager pull, which requires a sha256 and rejects the download with 409 checksum_mismatch otherwise) verify the bytes against it. Optional: simulate-mode runs and older services may omit it or return null. Single-file only; multi-file model directories are not covered by one digest.

resolved_config.description: The fully-merged ExperimentConfig actually used for this run — profile/workflow defaults with overrides (or the inline config) applied, resolved at creation time and frozen thereafter. Read this instead of re-resolving `profile` by name, since the profile definition may have changed since the run was created.

RunDetailsResponse.title: RunDetailsResponse
RunDetailsResponse.description: Full run record: the shared RunStatus plus per-iteration metrics.

created_by.title: Created By
created_by.description: Identity (bearer-token subject) that created this run. Set server-side at creation time; never client-supplied.

convergence_reason.title: Convergence Reason
convergence_reason.description: Why the loop stopped (set once terminal): kpi_met (KPI target reached), max_iterations_reached, delta_below_epsilon (mAP delta < convergence_epsilon), hard_stop (gate/error).
